you_should_know.title: St. Paul’s homeless encampment closures may be on pause indefinitely
you_should_know.summary: There are no scheduled dates to clear the remaining homeless encampments in St. Paul, the capital city, just east of Minneapolis, after city leaders called the closure of the camp at Pig's Eye Park, a riverfront park on the city's southeast edge, unsuccessful.
